phases.name: Foundation & Assessment
phases.focus: Establish safe aerobic base, movement quality, and light resistance while monitoring HR and symptoms.

phases.name: Build Endurance & Strength
phases.focus: Progress moderate-intensity aerobic volume and introduce progressive submaximal resistance to improve functional strength.

phases.name: Consolidation & Functional Conditioning
phases.focus: Maintain aerobic gains, increase functional multi-joint capacity and muscular endurance within cardiac limits.

non_negotiables: Cardiac rehab cleared him for moderate-intensity only.
Keep heart rate under 70% age-predicted max (~115 bpm).

stage2.text:
PLAN "12-week Cardiac-safe General Fitness" 
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS
  GOAL primary health:
    name "Improve aerobic capacity, movement quality, and functional strength within cardiac-safe limits"
PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation & Assessment" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Aerobic Moderate":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          walking 1x25 rpe 3 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 0m
      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Resistance Full-Body (Light–Moderate)":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 2x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 2x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 2x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 2x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          plank 2x30 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 30m "Active Recovery / Mobility":
        warmup:
          marching 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cat_cow 2x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x30 rpe 2 rest 15 seconds
          thoracic_rotation 2x8 rpe 2 rest 15 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
      DAY Sunday training 30m "Mixed Aerobic + Resistance (Short)":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 1x15 rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
          step_up 2x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 5m
